card.name: Leading digits inside numbers
card.fires_on: A single digit (mostly 6, 7, 8 or 9) that starts or sits inside a multi-digit number, such as view counts, page ranges, table values and decimals. It fires in lists of figures and citations.

modes.label: View counts
modes.description: The first digit of a view count that follows a headline on a web page.
modes.example: Around the Pier: A Story about Science<<9>>59 views

modes.label: Citation page numbers
modes.description: A digit starting a page or volume number in a reference.

modes.label: Table and statistic values
modes.description: A digit inside a table cell or a decimal in trial results.

card.writes: It promotes month-related Chinese words and number-continuation pieces, which suggests it helps predict what comes after a digit.
card.plain: It marks a high digit in the middle of a number such as a page range, view count or table value.
